subject: CAIQ clarifications & intake call — Zelda Therapeutics
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@zeldatech.com>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: CAIQ clarifications and intake call

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. We are in the middle of our vendor SIG/CAIQ review and wanted to schedule a short intake call to run through a few questions specific to data residency, access to raw logs for audit, and key rotation cadence. Two quick asks up front so we can prep on our side:

- Can you share a short pre-call packet or CAIQ snapshot (even a one-page mapping) so our security team can prioritize questions?
- We may need a brief recording of the intake call for our internal audit. Please confirm whether Redwood records calls and whether you can share a recording.

Availability windows next week (PST): Mon/Tue 10:00–12:30 or Wed 14:00–16:00. If none of these work we can be flexible.

Attached: none on my side yet — I will send our current question workbook if you confirm a slot.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Security Operations
Zelda Therapeutics

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: CAIQ clarifications and intake call

Elena — thanks for reaching out and the windows. We can do Tue 2026-09-01 at 10:30 PST. Kim (Head of Security Programs) and Irene (Compliance PM) will join.

Quick notes before the call:
- I attached a short CAIQ snapshot and a 2-page pre-call packet that highlights where Redwood maps controls to our SOC2 evidence and where we surface S3 log samples. See attachments: redwood_caiq_snapshot.pdf, redwood_precall_packet.pdf.
- We do record intake calls for internal notes; we can share the recording after the meeting if that works for you. If you prefer not to be recorded, let us know.

Proposed agenda (20–30 min):
1) Introductions and scope (5 min)
2) Zelda's priority questions (10–15 min)
3) Evidence handoff / next steps and timeline (5 min)

Attaching the files now. If you want us to review a specific sheet of your workbook ahead of time, please send it over.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena@zeldatech.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + request: CAIQ clarifications and intake call

Markus / team — Tue 10:30 PST works for us, confirmed. I attached our question workbook (zelda_sig_questions_v1.xlsx) — it's a prioritized list with 18 items, the top 6 are must-have. Two notes flagged in the sheet are:

- We specifically need a sample of the S3 audit logs for a 30-day window showing requester, object, and IP. Is that something Redwood can provide as a CSV sample (sanitized) or a short export guide?
- We also asked about KMS rotation cadence and whether keys are customer-controlled or Redwood-managed.

We consent to the call being recorded. If you could skim the workbook and flag any items you anticipate will need a follow-up artifact, that'd be super helpful.

Attached: zelda_sig_questions_v1.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet).

Thanks,
Elena

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena@zeldatech.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ clarifications & intake call — Zelda Therapeutics

Elena — great to meet you earlier, and thanks for sending the workbook in advance. Meeting notes + immediate action items below (recording link and attachments included):

Meeting summary (01 Sep 2026, 10:30 PST)
- Attendees: Elena Soto (Zelda), Zelda Security Team (security@zeldatech.com), Markus Klein (Redwood), Kim Park (Redwood), Irene Choi (Redwood)
- Duration: 28 minutes
- Recording: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-zelda-precall (consent provided)

Key Q&A highlights
1) S3 audit log sample: We can provide a sanitized CSV export that includes timestamp, requester principal (ARN/email), object key prefix, and source IP. We agreed Redwood will deliver a 30-day sample within 5 business days. Action: Irene to coordinate the export and redact personal identifiers.

2) KMS / key rotation: Redwood uses customer-specific KMS keys for Private deployments (customer-managed) and Redwood-managed rotating keys for Hosted. Default for Zelda (hosted onboarding) is Redwood-managed keys; we documented rotation cadence in the pre-call packet (90 days for envelope keys, CMK rotation policy summarized). Action: Markus to follow up with a short note clarifying rotation for cross-account access patterns.

3) CAIQ control clarifications: We flagged 4 items in the workbook that require artifacts (log retention policy, sample GCP/pubsub configs for streaming ingestion, SOC2 control mapping). Action: Kim to attach SOC2 excerpt and mapping doc; Markus to add timeline for artifact delivery.

Attachments added to the shared drive: redwood_soc2_excerpt.pdf, redwood_log_retention_policy.docx.

Action items & owners
- Irene Choi (redwood): Prepare sanitized S3 log CSV sample (due 2026-09-08)
- Markus Klein (redwood): Follow up on KMS rotation note + timeline for remaining artifacts (due 2026-09-03)
- Kim Park (redwood): Share SOC2 excerpt and mapping doc to CAIQ workbook (done)
- Elena / Zelda: Confirm whether the sanitized CSV format is acceptable once you receive it.

Next steps
- Redwood will upload the artifacts to the shared drive and add a HubSpot activity record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
- If Zelda needs an evidence-only deep dive, we can schedule a 45-minute follow-up.

Thanks again — we'll circle back on the timeline items.

Best,
Kim Park
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_soc2_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 3 pages), redwood_log_retention_policy.docx (DOCX, 1 page)
